_comment: Pins the note retrieval rules on both sides: the on-device chat page (miniapps/on-device-chat/index.html pickChunks; run tools/test_retrieval.py) and the iOS app (PersonaNoteRetrieval; PersonaNotesTests). Each case picks notes for `query` from `<pack>/chunks.json` with the on-device budget (1500 chars, 3 notes). `expectFirst`: the first note's id. `expectAll`: every id must be among the picks. `expectWithinTop`: the id is among the first N. `expectGroup`: every pick's group/story. `expectExcludes`: none of these ids. `progressBefore`/`expectProgress`: the gate's reader position before and after the query.

cases.query: What was Caesar's edge at Alesia?
How many miles of works did the Romans build?
Why did the Spanish Armada fail?
Where do I get the Android app?
Do my chats sync between Mac and iPhone?
How do I chat with no API key?
How do I add my own persona?
What did you think of the man in the library?
Tell me about the valley of ashes
How do I make stream water safe to drink?
How do I start a fire without matches?
How much water should I store per person?
Will boiling remove chemicals from flood water?
